How to use SiteProof

For contractors and their crews who want one record per job, from the first photo to the paid invoice, and for anyone who wants to see the method in the live demo before reading the books.

Open SiteProof ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Open getsiteproof.vercel.app/demo and press Open the live demo. You get your own private copy of Summit Ridge Builders, a fictional company.

2

Start on Home, then open Jobs and switch to Board to see every job by stage.

3

Open Hendricks roof replacement: photos, daily logs, checklists, chat and the Details tab with sign-offs and guest links.

4

Make a customer link or open a report, then open it as your customer would.

5

Your copy is deleted after 24 hours. Start over with a fresh copy at any time from the demo page.

02

Features

01

Home and the job board

Home puts the three most frequent actions first: take a photo, start a job, clock in, with today's photos, active jobs, open tasks and hours. The board shows every job as a card in a column by stage, from Lead to Done; a job moves by dragging on a computer or with Move to on a phone.

STEPS

  1. Open Jobs, then Board
  2. Drag a card, or use Move to
  3. Open a card to see the job
02

A job and its photos

Photos and short videos are taken straight into the job and labeled Before, During or After. Without signal, they wait on the phone and upload by themselves later. Each photo keeps its caption, typed or dictated, its tags and what the phone recorded about when it was taken.

STEPS

  1. Open a job and press Take Photo
  2. Choose the label for new photos
  3. Open a photo to add a caption with Talk
03

Markup

Arrows, circles, boxes, drawing, text and dimension lines on a copy of the photo. The original is always kept unchanged, and customer links can show the marked-up copy or the original.

STEPS

  1. Open a photo, then Mark up
  2. Pick a tool and a color
  3. Press Save markup
04

Compare and reports

Two photos of a job side by side or under a slider, and a button that turns the pair into a Before & After report. Reports come in three templates, Progress, Before & After and Completion, and are built as PDFs with the company's logo and the job's facts.

STEPS

  1. Select two photos in a job, then Compare
  2. Press Make a Before & After report
  3. Open Reports and press Download PDF
05

Daily logs and checklists

One log per job per day: weather, crew, hours filled in from the time clock, work done and problems, dictated if needed, printable as a one-page record with that day's photos. Checklists come from templates and record who ticked each item and when.

STEPS

  1. Open a job's Daily log tab
  2. Fill in the day and press Save
  3. Open Checklists and tick the items on site
06

Sign-offs

A change order, a completion, a walkthrough or an agreement, signed on the crew's phone with the crew member recorded as witness, or from a link sent to the customer. The exact statement, the typed name, the drawn signature and the time are kept together and cannot be edited.

STEPS

  1. Open a job's Details tab
  2. Press Ask for a signature and choose the kind
  3. Sign on this phone, or send the link
07

Estimates

Line items typed or picked from the price book, tax, a deposit percentage and notes. The customer opens a private page, reads each line, signs and accepts or declines; an accepted estimate becomes a deposit or final invoice in one step.

STEPS

  1. Open Estimates and press New estimate
  2. Add lines from the price book
  3. Press Create customer link and send it
08

Invoices and payments

Deposit, progress and final invoices tied to the job and the customer, with what is outstanding, overdue and paid this month. A Pay online button can open the contractor's own payment page; payments by check, cash, card or transfer are recorded and the status updates itself.

STEPS

  1. Open Invoices
  2. Filter by Unpaid or Partly paid
  3. Open an invoice and press Record payment
09

Guest links for subcontractors

A link for one job lets a subcontractor add photos without an account or a seat. Each photo arrives with the guest's name; the link has an end date, can be turned off at any time, and shows other photos only if allowed.

STEPS

  1. Open a job's Details tab
  2. Press Invite a guest
  3. Send the link; turn it off when the work is done
10

Customer portal

One private page per customer gathers every gallery, report, estimate, invoice and sign-off shared with them. Internal notes, team chat and photo locations never appear on it unless a link was set to show locations.

STEPS

  1. Open Customers and choose a customer
  2. Press Create portal link
  3. Send the link to the customer
11

The day at a glance

The home screen for the owner and the crew: the latest photos from every job, the jobs updated most recently and the tasks due, with the camera always in the middle of the bottom bar.

STEPS

  1. Open Home
  2. Tap a photo to open its job
  3. Tick a task when it is done
03Tips
  • Take the before photos room by room on the first morning, and tag anything already damaged. It is the record most often needed later.
  • Make no change without a signed sign-off, even when the price does not change.
  • Put the shot list of your trade into a checklist template, so every crew photographs the same things.
04FAQ
Does the crew need to install an app?

No. SiteProof runs in the phone's browser and can be added to the home screen.

What happens without signal?

Photos and videos are saved on the phone and upload by themselves when it reconnects. Until then they exist only on that phone.

Can customers see internal notes?

Never. Notes and chat stay inside the company, and addresses and photo locations are hidden on customer links unless a link is set to show them.

Does SiteProof process card payments?

No. An invoice can show a button that opens the contractor's own payment page; payments are then recorded in SiteProof.

Does AI look at the photos?

Only if the AI helpers are switched on and someone presses an AI button. Then only that photo, without location or camera data, or the selected text is sent, and the helpers are told never to invent work, dates or prices.

Is storage unlimited?

No. Solo includes 15 GB and Team 75 GB. Originals are kept uncompressed; nothing is deleted when a limit is reached, new uploads are refused with a clear message.
